title: Hyperfine parser speedup vs noise
what: JSON parser mean runtime speedup (%) or ms saved on branch vs main

reader_questions.question: How much faster is the JSON parser on the refactor branch compared to main?
reader_questions.expected: About 30.8% faster (56.8 ms saved, from 184.3 ms to 127.5 ms).

reader_questions.question: Are the JSON and YAML differences outside run-to-run noise?
reader_questions.expected: JSON speedup is well outside ±1 s.d. (3.8 and 3.8 ms); YAML (0.1%) is within overlapping ±1 s.d.

reader_questions.question: What happened to the YAML parser on the branch?
reader_questions.expected: YAML parser showed no real speedup (239.3 ms vs 239.1 ms, overlapping s.d.).
